overview_description.description: Roundtable provides a platform to detect bots and prevent fraud on websites and applications. Their flagship product, Proof of Human, leverages behavioral biometrics and continuous behavioral AI to detect and block bots, AI-generated responses, and other fraudulent activities without disrupting genuine user experiences. The system analyzes user behavior, such as typing, scrolling, and cursor movement, to identify automated or suspicious activity. It operates without interrupting real users and does not use intrusive CAPTCHA. The platform includes a dashboard and a real-time API for monitoring traffic and security events. Businesses of different sizes can use Roundtable to protect transactions, prevent account duplication, and secure their platforms from malicious activity.
